references.text: The same context regarding who may not eat of the holy things: a foreigner shall not eat of the holy offering.
Continuation of the law: If a priest's daughter becomes a widow or is divorced and returns to her father's house, she may again eat of the holy things.
Describes who has the right to eat of the heave offering (terumah) - the priests and their households.
Refers to the daughters of priests who may eat of certain holy gifts together with their families.
Ezekiel's law concerning the marriage of priests: they shall not take a widow or a divorced woman, but virgins from the offspring of Israel or a priest's widow.
